title: Quantum Circuit for General Unitary: Improved T-count via Block Flattening and Dilation
summary: Synthesizing arbitrary $n$-qubit unitaries using as few non-Clifford gates as possible is a central problem in fault-tolerant quantum compilation. We present a Clifford+$T$ quantum circuit construction that approximately implements any classically specified unitary to within error $ε$ and achieves a worst-case $T$-count with leading exponential scaling of $2^{5n/4}$ whenever $\log(1/ε)=\operatorname{poly}(n)$.
